rule.en: Dive the wreck with rival divers, grab treasure, and get back before the air or Papa the shark runs out your luck.
rule.sw: Piga mbizi kwenye mabaki na wapinzani, chukua hazina, urudi kabla hewa au Papa hajakumaliza.

en: Roll to dive, take treasure, then turn back for the jahazi. Every treasure you carry slows you and drains the shared tank.
Papa the shark rises each round. If he reaches you, feed him a treasure or lose all you carry. Deep tiles may be mimics.
Three dives. Only treasure you bring back to the boat counts.
sw: Rusha kete kuzama, chukua hazina, kisha rudi kwenye jahazi. Kila hazina unayobeba inakupunguza kasi na kumaliza tangi la pamoja.
Papa anapanda kila raundi. Akikufikia, mlishe hazina au upoteze vyote unavyobeba. Vigae vya chini vinaweza kuwa vya udanganyifu.
Mbizi tatu. Hazina unayoirudisha jahazini pekee ndiyo inahesabiwa.

desc.en: Before dive 1 you may move one tile anywhere in the trench. Lift gold shallow for a safer grab, but rivals can take it too.
desc.sw: Kabla ya mbizi ya kwanza unaweza kuhamisha kigae kimoja popote kwenye mfereji. Pandisha dhahabu juu upate kwa urahisi, lakini wapinzani nao wanaweza kuichukua.

source.en: Kiothi, where one pit's seeds may be redistributed anywhere before play begins
source.sw: Kiothi, ambapo mbegu za shimo moja zinaweza kugawanywa popote kabla ya mchezo kuanza

en.z_yourturn: Your turn. Keep diving, or turn back for good?
en.z_yourturn_up: Your turn. Keep swimming for the jahazi.
en.z_maybe_mimic: You landed on {name}. Could be a mimic.
en.z_pile: A pile of sunken treasure sits here.
en.z_empty: Empty spot. You can drop a treasure here to lighten your load.
en.z_mimic_you: It was a mimic! An anglerfish lunges and Papa surges 2 spaces closer.
en.z_mimic_them: {name} grabbed a mimic. Papa surges 2 spaces closer.
en.z_reached: Papa reached you! Feed him a treasure to push him back, or lose everything you carry.
en.z_flee: Papa reached you with nothing to feed him. You flee to the jahazi, out for this dive.
en.z_fed: You fed Papa {v} worth of {name}. He sinks back {b}.
en.z_caught_them: Papa caught {name}. Their loot sinks to the bottom.
en.z_chased: Papa chased {name} out of the water.
en.z_caught_you: Papa caught you. Your loot sinks to the bottom.
en.z_back: You made it back to the jahazi and banked {v}.
en.z_airout: The tank is empty! Everyone still underwater drops their loot.
en.z_start: Three dives. Only treasure you bring back to the jahazi counts.
en.z_refill: Dive {n} begins. The tank is refilled.
en.z_nextinfo: Next dive: {name}. {desc} Taken tiles are cleared and lost loot sinks to the bottom in piles.
en.z_place2: Second place. One rival out-dived you.
en.z_seed_body: Pick one tile, then pick where it goes. Lift gold shallow, or bury it deep.
en.z_seed_done: Moved a {name} tile from depth {a} to {b}.
en.z_resume_body: You were on dive {n}. Pick up where you left off?
en.ev_calm_d: Papa rises one space slower each round.
en.ev_current_d: Move 1 extra space diving down, 1 fewer swimming up.
en.ev_bloom_d: Every tile shows its value, and mimics glow red.
en.ev_leak_d: The tank starts at 20 instead of 25.
en.ev_frenzy_d: Papa rises one space faster, but feeding him pushes him back twice as far.
en.z_tie: Level with a rival at the top.

sw.z_yourturn: Zamu yako. Endelea kuzama, au geuka kabisa?
sw.z_yourturn_up: Zamu yako. Endelea kuogelea kuelekea jahazi.
sw.z_pile: Rundo la hazina iliyozama liko hapa.
sw.z_empty: Nafasi tupu. Unaweza kudondosha hazina hapa upunguze mzigo.
sw.z_mimic_you: Ni udanganyifu! Samaki anarukia na Papa anasogea nafasi 2 karibu.
sw.z_mimic_them: {name} amechukua udanganyifu. Papa anasogea nafasi 2 karibu.
sw.z_reached: Papa amekufikia! Mlishe hazina umrudishe nyuma, au upoteze vyote unavyobeba.
sw.z_flee: Papa amekufikia na huna cha kumlisha. Unakimbilia jahazi, umetoka mbizi hii.
sw.z_fed: Umemlisha Papa {name} yenye thamani {v}. Anarudi nyuma {b}.
sw.z_airout: Tangi limeisha hewa! Kila aliye majini anadondosha hazina.
sw.z_start: Mbizi tatu. Hazina unayorudisha jahazini pekee ndiyo inahesabiwa.
sw.z_nextinfo: Mbizi ijayo: {name}. {desc} Vigae vilivyochukuliwa vinaondolewa na hazina iliyopotea inazama kwa marundo.
sw.z_place2: Nafasi ya pili. Mpinzani mmoja amekushinda.
sw.z_seed_body: Chagua kigae kimoja, kisha chagua kinakokwenda. Pandisha dhahabu juu, au izike chini.
sw.z_seed_done: Umehamisha kigae cha {name} kutoka kina {a} hadi {b}.
sw.z_resume_body: Ulikuwa kwenye mbizi ya {n}. Uendelee ulipoachia?
sw.ev_calm_d: Papa anapanda nafasi moja polepole kila raundi.
sw.ev_current_d: Songa nafasi 1 zaidi ukizama, 1 pungufu ukipanda.
sw.ev_bloom_d: Kila kigae kinaonyesha thamani yake, na udanganyifu unang'aa mwekundu.
sw.ev_frenzy_d: Papa anapanda nafasi moja haraka, lakini ukimlisha anarudi nyuma mara mbili.
